title: Learning Normal Diffusion Dynamics for Backdoor Defense in Text-to-Image Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.39548v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to the secure deployment of text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models. Existing defenses typically detect backdoors from specific abnormal patterns in internal representations, which may limit their generalizability with the emergence of increasingly diverse attack mechanisms. In this paper, we study backdoor defense of T2I diffusion models from a transition-dynamics perspective. We observe that benign diffusion trajectories exhibit structured and timestep-dependent transition patterns from cross-attention, latent and noise spaces, whereas backdoor attacks tend to induce deviations from such normal evolution. Motivated by these observations, we propose Normal Diffusion Dynamics Learning (NDDL), a novel backdoor defense framework that learns the normal transition dynamics of diffusion trajectories utilizing only benign samples. translated_title: 面向文本到图像模型后门防御的正常扩散动态学习
translated_abstract: 后门攻击对文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型的安全部署构成严重威胁。现有防御方法通常通过内部表示中的特定异常模式来检测后门，随着日益多样化的攻击机制的出现，这可能限制其泛化能力。在本文中，我们从转移动力学的角度研究T2I扩散模型的后门防御。我们观察到良性扩散轨迹在交叉注意力、潜空间和噪声空间中表现出结构化的、依赖于时间步的转移模式，而后门攻击往往会引起对此类正常演化的偏离。受这些观察的启发，我们提出了正常扩散动态学习（NDDL），这是一种新颖的后门防御框架，仅利用良性样本即可学习扩散轨迹的正常转移动态。NDDL构建紧凑的多空间轨迹表示，并训练一个……
tldr: 提出NDDL后门防御框架，仅利用良性样本学习扩散轨迹在交叉注意力、潜空间和噪声空间中的正常转移动态，从转移动力学角度识别偏离正常演化的后门攻击。
en_tdlr: Proposes NDDL, a backdoor defense framework that learns normal transition dynamics of diffusion trajectories across cross-attention, latent, and noise spaces using only benign samples, detecting backdoor attacks that deviate from normal evolution from a transition-dynamics perspective.
